principle: D and E are abstract ribbon companions, not humanoid mascots. Their personality and action language come from ribbon/body deformation, orientation, eyes and mouth; V1 has no limbs.
invariants: Both characters have 0 arms, 0 hands, 0 legs and 0 feet in V1.
No semantic state may invent limbs.
Expression comes from eyes, brows, mouth, body/ribbon deformation and orientation.
Pointing/presenting behavior must use ribbon orientation, UI emphasis or environmental highlighting rather than a hand.
Character differences come from ribbon geometry, palette, energy and motion language, not incompatible anatomy.

v1_state_language.CORRECT: soft orientation + reduced energy + supportive expression

rig_layer_requirement.base_character_rule: Keep eye whites/outlines and core face/ribbon geometry in the base. Remove only controls that must move/change independently.
rig_layer_requirement.body_motion: Use bounded whole-character/ribbon deformation and transforms first; split ribbon forms only if a real state cannot be expressed cleanly.

future_upgrade_rule: If a real product need later proves a gesture appendage is necessary, open a versioned anatomy change for BOTH D and E and re-run rig/state/device QA. Do not silently add limbs to one state or one character.
